title: Agent Enhancer Utilities
description: Workflow planning, recovery checkpoints, coordination, fixtures, and compatibility tools for agents.
summary: Workflow planning, recovery checkpoints, coordination, fixtures, and compatibility tools for agents.

toolsPreview.name: lab.search_tools
toolsPreview.description: Find Agent Enhancer Utilities tools that match a concrete intent. Returns compact machine-readable manifests.

toolsPreview.name: lab.describe_tool
toolsPreview.description: Get the exact schema, price, limits, side effects, retention, and HTTP endpoint for one utility.

toolsPreview.name: lab.invoke_tool
toolsPreview.description: Invoke a free utility directly. For paid utilities, returns the HTTP endpoint and payment requirement so an x402-capable client can complete the call.

toolsPreview.name: lab.request_capability
toolsPreview.description: Submit a free, private backlog request when no existing utility solves a concrete problem. Do not include secrets, personal data, or full conversation history.

toolsPreview.name: lab.get_capability_request
toolsPreview.description: Poll a previously submitted capability request with its private status token.

toolsPreview.name: lab.list_tools
toolsPreview.description: List all currently discoverable utilities. Prefer search_tools when a concrete intent is known.
